title: OL08-02 Closure Quiescence Certification

permissions.reason: This certification adds no runtime permission or authorization surface; it verifies the already-accepted OL08 SYSTEM closure boundary remains subject to existing OL07 lifecycle guards.

permissions.reason: No runtime permission is added or changed.

backend.reason: Production backend behavior is intentionally unchanged; existing OL07/OL08 runtime is only certified.

notes: Certification-only OL08-02. It proves an open OL08 closure execution cannot bypass existing OL07 queued pre-start cancellation, running safe checkpoints, final provider handoff blocking, lifecycle-authority fail-closed behavior, suspension-cancelled terminality, or ambiguous in-flight no-auto-retry semantics. No new cancellation framework, export runtime, destructive cleanup, retention policy or Core tombstone behavior is added.
